sources.settings: Our storms bring the hurricane, the downpour and the snow, so EW's own rolls of them are off. A tornado's storm clouds force EW's hurricane sky on every loaded region; our hurricane keeps its own sky
sources.minPresence: Balance: the hurricane's core, within about a fifth of its radius of the eye, where its wind blows at storm force and beyond
sources.checkSeconds: EW's own cadence: TornadoSystem rolls TornadoChance every 300 s while its hurricane blows
